text:
Julie: Quick billing heads-up — beginning 2026-04-15 we're rolling out a per-route surge surcharge and an accompanying clarification to how free credits apply during burst windows for hosted API customers. TL;DR: when a single route exceeds an 80% utilization threshold for a 5-minute sliding window, a temporary per-token surcharge may be applied to requests on that route.

Julie: Key points:
- Applies to hosted API routes only (Dedicated/Private unchanged unless customer opts-in by contract).
- Threshold: 80% route capacity sustained over 5 minutes.
- Surcharge band: starts at +10% of per-token unit price, can scale up to +25% for extreme saturation.
- Free credits: during surcharge windows customers will still consume credits, but we will show an "adjusted credit application" line on invoice previews to make impact transparent.
- Rollout: opt-in preview starts 2026-03-29; mandatory for new accounts 2026-04-15; existing accounts moved to opt-outable enforcement window through May 2026.

Julie: Why: to reduce noisy hotspots and keep tail latency predictable while preserving capacity fairness. We expect this to lower system-wide throttles and improve latency SLOs.

Alex: Is this charged retroactively for current billing cycle?
Julie: No retroactive charges. Surcharges start on the official rollout dates and will appear on invoices generated after the effective date.

Maria: How do we measure "route capacity"? Is that per-model, per-API-key, per-route?
Julie: It's per-route + model combination (route means the API endpoint + model id). We use 1-min and 5-min utilization metrics; surcharge triggers on the 5-min sliding window. Dashboard panels will show the metric.

Chris: Can teams avoid the surcharge without changing traffic patterns? Any console flags?
Julie: Yes — two options: 1) set a soft cap on a route in Console to auto-reject or queue above-X requests, 2) enable per-route autoscaling (for Dedicated customers) or request capacity increases via support. We will add a console banner and an API flag `surcharge_protection` to configure behavior.

BillingBot: Invoice preview for account redwood-internal updated (2026-03-22). Line item: "per-route-surge-preview" — this is a preview only and will not be billed until the effective date.

Julie: Docs link: https://redwood.internal/docs/billing/per-route-surge (internal). If you represent a large customer or need an exception, please reach out to billing@redwood.ai or ping @Sales. We'll host an office hours session next Tue 10am PT to walk through examples.
